speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I need to examine your skin lesions to assess for potential oncologic implications; can you describe their appearance, size, and how quickly they have changed?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC) of the penis and finger.

Based on your history of heavy smoking, the lesion's non-healing, red, and crusty appearance, and its location, this is highly suspicious for Squamous Cell Carcinoma. To confirm this, I need you to undergo a biopsy of both lesions and please provide the results immediately.
